new.heading: Create a demo link
new.companyPlaceholder: Optional — the AI introduces itself in this name
new.nichePlaceholder: Optional — overrides the Client and generates a new persona
new.fallback: The niche model did not run, so this link carries a generic persona rather than the niche you asked for.
new.websiteFailed: Could not read that site. Create the Client manually.
new.websiteHint: Reads their site and builds a Client with their real services, hours and area.
new.notesPlaceholder: Paste what you know: services, area, hours, how they quote...
new.providerHint: OpenAI takes over if Claude fails.

services.heading: Demos for this prospect
services.hint: One persona, one link per service. Pick the Client above first.
services.needClient: Choose or scan a Client first.

publicDemo.title: Website demo on leadawaker.com
publicDemo.hint: Visitors type their website, verify their phone on WhatsApp, and talk to Sara as their own receptionist. Turn it off and the page shows "book a call" instead.
publicDemo.today: Today: €{{eur}} of €{{budget}} estimated, {{built}} of {{cap}} demos built.

settings.empty: No settings for this service yet.

widget.avatarHint: Shown on the launcher bubble, the chat header and every reply, in every widget demo.
widget.avatarError: That image could not be read. Try a PNG, JPG or WebP.

voice.voicesHint: Which voice answers the phone in each language. Changes reach the next call, not one already running.
voice.engineDown: Could not reach the voice engine, so these cannot be edited right now.
voice.passwordHint: Extra words that open the demo page, separated by commas. The built-in ones keep working.
voice.limitHint: How long one demo call may run before it ends itself.

phone.title: Office sound on the phone line
phone.hint: Plays a quiet office under her voice on {{number}}. On: calls go through a Telnyx conference (about $0.007 a minute more). Off: calls go straight to OpenAI, as before.
phone.onState: On: callers hear the office. Takes effect on the next call.
phone.offState: Off: calls go straight to OpenAI, with no room sound.
phone.levelHint: How loud the office is under her voice. Reaches the next call.

jitter.title: Smooth audio (jitter buffer)
jitter.hint: Holds {{min}} to {{max}} ms of her audio at Telnyx so uneven packets from OpenAI play without tiny dropouts. Adds up to {{max}} ms of delay. Applies to every call on the line.
jitter.onState: On: smoother audio, up to {{max}} ms later. Takes effect on the next call.
jitter.offState: Off: lowest delay, small dropouts are possible.

widgetColor.title: Widget colour
widgetColor.hint: Colours the launcher button only. Detected from their website; black when there is none.

clientLogo.title: Client logo
clientLogo.hint: Shown instead of the initials in the Instagram and Reputation demos. Applies to every demo of this Client.
clientLogo.none: No logo yet: the initials show.
clientLogo.noWebsite: This Client has no website on file.
